scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: The TCR activation–HNRNPLL–PTPRC alternative-splicing mechanism is well established and biologically coherent for human T cells. Its attribution of variation across all mixed cord-blood populations, particularly B and myeloid cells, is broader than the cited evidence supports.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: The response explicitly connects naive versus activated state, TCR signaling, HNRNPLL induction, PTPRC exon exclusion, and the reciprocal CD45RA/CD45RO phenotype. The extension to naive B cells and the broader mixed-population variation is less mechanistically resolved than the T-cell pathway. No synthesis ceiling was applied because the principal focus-to-target mechanism is explicit, multistep, and biologically defensible.
